description_en: Queries the progress details of tasks generated through API operations, such as creating a cluster
description_zh: 查看通过API生成的任务（如创建集群）进度详情
name: DescribeTasks

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.
You must specify either `DBNodeId` or `DBClusterId`. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to query the details of all clusters under your account, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
`DBNodeId`和`DBClusterId`必选其一填入。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看账号下所有集群的详细信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The node ID.
You must specify either `DBNodeId` or `DBClusterId`. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to query the details of all clusters under your account, including node IDs
parameters.help_zh:
节点ID。
`DBNodeId`和`DBClusterId`必选其一填入。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看账号下所有集群的详细信息，包括节点ID
parameters.name: db_node_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ`（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，查询结束时间需晚于开始时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ`（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The task status. Valid values:
Waiting: The task is waiting to be executed.
Running: The task is being executed.
Finished: The task is completed.
Closed: The task is closed.
Pause: The task is paused.
Stop: The task is interrupted.

If this parameter is left empty, only the details of tasks in the Waiting or Running state for the current cluster or node are returned.
You can specify multiple task statuses separated by commas
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态，取值范围如下：
Waiting：任务等待执行中
Running：任务正在执行中
Finished：任务已完成
Closed：任务已关闭
Pause：任务已暂停
Stop：任务已中断

若该参数留空，仅返回当前集群或节点下所有状态为Waiting或Running的任务详情。
支持输入多个任务状态，各状态之间用逗号分割查询
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100.

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值为30、50或100。

默认值为30。
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值。

默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

DBClusterId.description_en: The cluster ID associated with the task

EndTime.description_en:
The end time of the query.

The time is in the ISO 8601 standard in the UTC time zone (format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ)
EndTime.description_zh:
查询结束时间。

时间采用 ISO 8601 格式，时区为 UTC（格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ）

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of records on the current page

StartTime.description_en:
The start time of the query.

The time is in the ISO 8601 standard in the UTC time zone (format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ)
StartTime.description_zh:
查询开始时间。

时间采用 ISO 8601 格式，时区为 UTC（格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ）

BeginTime.description_en: The time when the task started. The time is in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format (UTC)
BeginTime.description_zh: 任务开始时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）

CurrentStepName.description_en: The name of the current substep of the task
CurrentStepName.description_zh: 当前任务的子步骤名称

DBName.description_en:
The database name.
This parameter is returned only for tasks that involve database-related operations
DBName.description_zh:
数据库名称。
仅涉及数据库相关操作的任务会返回该参数

ExpectedFinishTime.description_en: The expected end time. This parameter is empty if no special circumstances exist
ExpectedFinishTime.description_zh: 预计结束时间。若无特殊情况，该参数为空

FinishTime.description_en: The time when the task was completed. The time is in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format (UTC)
FinishTime.description_zh: 任务完成时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）

ProgressInfo.description_en: The description of the task progress. This parameter is empty if the target task has no progress description
ProgressInfo.description_zh: 任务进度的描述信息。若目标任务无进度描述信息，该参数为空

Remain.description_en: The estimated remaining time of the task. Unit: seconds
Remain.description_zh: 任务预计剩余时间，单位为秒

StepProgressInfo.description_en: The substep progress of the task. For example, `1/4` indicates that the task contains four substeps and the first substep is being executed
StepProgressInfo.description_zh: 任务子步骤进度。例如`1/4`表示该任务共包含4个子步骤，当前正在执行第一步

StepsInfo.description_en: The details of the task substeps

TaskAction.description_en: The API operation used by the target task, such as `CreateDBInstance`
TaskAction.description_zh: 目标任务所使用的API接口，例如`CreateDBInstance`

TaskErrorCode.description_en:
The error code returned when the task fails.
This parameter is returned only when the task status is Stop
TaskErrorCode.description_zh:
任务出错时的错误码。
仅当任务状态为Stop时返回该参数

TaskErrorMessage.description_en:
The error message returned when the task fails.
This parameter is returned only when the task status is Stop
TaskErrorMessage.description_zh:
任务出错时的错误信息。
仅当任务状态为Stop时返回该参数

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the target task
